findings.detail: Active source 418 strict standalone accession chart headings + 4 decorated standalone chart headings = 422 document charts; Revision 2 400 + 3 = 403.
Active 422 chart headings normalize to 420 distinct accession strings because BN5-F8(A/B/C) share accession BN5-F8. The historical 421 active candidate strings differ only by unsupported EN1-F1.

EN1-F1 is present in FIELDMASTER PR19 421-active candidates, but no standalone EN1-F1 heading exists in fetched active text. Substring or prefix extraction may explain it, but exact historical extractor source was not found by repository code search.
Active document has four BN5-F8(B) microscopy image labels and one BN5-F25 microscopy plate label. These must not become independent chart headings.
BN5-F8 variants are separately headed chart sections, not authenticated separate physical vouchers. AN2-F10/F12/F22 provenance remains bounded by R6. 477 remains an unverified target.
